astonish.zh: 他的记忆力总让我吃惊。

fright.en: The boy fell of fright when he saw a ghost.
fright.zh: 那个男孩子见到鬼的时候吓了一跳。

forfeit.en: You refuse a toast, only to be forced to drink a forfeit.

naughty.en: That little naughty one is running around the living room again!
naughty.zh: 這個小皮蛋，又在客廳亂跑！

fluctuate.en: The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
fluctuate.zh: 該政策在兩種意見之間搖擺。

fluctuate.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.

overcoat.en: In winter I wear an overcoat.

shopkeeper.en: He couldn't find the restroom, so he had to ask the shopkeeper for directions.
shopkeeper.zh: 他找不到洗手間，只好向店員詢問方向。

compulsory.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.

sneeze.en: I think I'm gonna sneeze. Give me a tissue.
sneeze.zh: 我想我要打喷嚏了。。。给我张纸巾。

sneeze.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
sneeze.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

equator.en: That ship crossed the equator yesterday.
equator.zh: 那条船昨天穿过了赤道。

equator.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
equator.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。

twinkle.en: Many stars are twinkling in the sky.
twinkle.zh: 一顆一顆的星星在空中閃閃發光。

twinkle.en: Countless stars were twinkling in the sky.

cunning.en: People say that the fox is more cunning than other animals.
cunning.zh: 人们说，狐狸比其他动物要狡猾。

chap.en: I get chapped lips every winter.
chap.zh: 每年冬天，我的嘴唇都会干裂。

wholesome.en: She prepares wholesome meals for her family.
wholesome.zh: 她为她的家人准备健康餐。

treason.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
treason.zh: 在一些國家，叛國罪的懲罰可以是終身監禁。

innumerable.en: I have tried innumerable times to contact him.

redundant.en: I'm sorry to have to tell you that you've been made redundant.
redundant.zh: 非常不幸地通知您，您被辞退了。

recur.en: Did you ever have a recurring dream?
recur.zh: 你有過一個你會重複做的夢嗎？

oppress.en: The government of this country oppresses its people.
oppress.zh: 这个国家的政府压迫人民。

sarcastic.en: Don't you think the name "The Sacred War" sounds a bit sarcastic?
sarcastic.zh: 你不覺得這個名字很諷刺嗎，「神聖的戰爭」？

transistor.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
transistor.zh: 晶體管的發明標誌著一個新時代的開始。

junction.en: This junction is notorious for accidents.
junction.zh: 這個路口因頻繁的事故而臭名昭著。

junction.en: We need to go right at the next junction.
junction.zh: 我們得在下一個路口右拐。

piston.en: The piston does not come into contact with the cylinder cover.
piston.zh: 这个活塞不接触汽缸盖。

haste.en: He left the office in great haste.
haste.zh: 他急急忙忙地离开了办公室。

spade.en: Jane calls a spade a spade.
spade.zh: 珍是一個有話直說的人。

pretext.en: Jonas left under the pretext of going to the bathroom.
pretext.zh: 喬納斯以去洗手間為藉口離開了。

pretext.en: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
pretext.zh: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

perseverance.en: I was surprised by his perseverance.
perseverance.zh: 我对他的坚持感到很惊讶。

vowel.en: French has many more vowels than Japanese.
vowel.zh: 法语的元音比日语的多得多。

vowel.en: Are there any languages with no vowels?
vowel.zh: 有没有没有元音的语言？

noun.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
noun.zh: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。

bibliography.en: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.

diligent.zh: 一般來說，日本人很勤奮。

avail.zh: 沒有仁愛的美麗毫無用處

maiden.en: The Titanic's maiden voyage didn't go so well.
maiden.zh: 泰塔尼克号的首航不是很好的。

maiden.en: I'm planning to take my mother's maiden name.

refreshment.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
refreshment.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

obedient.en: He was a great teacher so his children were very obedient.
obedient.zh: 他很会教育人，所以他的孩子都很听话。

irrespective.en: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.
irrespective.zh: 她不論黨派把票投給了西岡先生。

sportsman.en: He looks like a sportsman, but he is a writer.
sportsman.zh: 他看起来像个运动员，但是其实是个作家。

stationery.en: All of this stationery is his.

judgement.en: We can rely on his judgement.
judgement.zh: 我們可以信賴他的判斷。

malfunction.en: This clock seems to be malfunctioning.
The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
malfunction.zh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

tram.zh: 我們的城市有有軌電車。

tram.en: The tram will arrive on time.

violet.en: This flower is violet in color.

contrive.en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
contrive.zh: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

pronunciation.zh: 這不是標準的英式讀法。

amplifier.zh: 昨天我組裝了一個揚聲器。

circumference.en: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
circumference.zh: 用圓周能不能求得直徑？

housework.en: We agreed to share the housework.

concise.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
concise.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

concise.en: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
concise.zh: 两者都可以，但是前者更简洁。

invert.en: Through the lens the image was inverted.

sightseeing.en: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
sightseeing.zh: 觀光巴士穿過了一條長長的隧道。

superfluous.en: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
superfluous.zh: 在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。

dialog.en: I did not participate in the dialog.

trifle.zh: 不要把時間浪費在瑣事上

trifle.en: Their trouble stems from a trifling matter.
trifle.zh: 他們的煩惱是由一件瑣碎的事而起的。

inverse.en: The inverse of a non-square matrix is a dangerous thing.
inverse.zh: 非方矩阵的逆阵是一个危险的东西。

repent.en: He repented having betrayed his country to the enemy.
repent.zh: 他後悔對敵人出賣了他的國家。

monotonous.en: I am tired of my monotonous life.
monotonous.zh: 我厌倦了现在单调的生活。

considerate.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
considerate.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

adjoin.en: The living room adjoins the dining room.

zigzag.zh: 汤姆在车流中来回穿行。

zigzag.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
zigzag.zh: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

tiresome.en: If your children are being tiresome, you will feel time passing slowly.
tiresome.zh: 如果你的孩子很辛苦你觉得日子很漫长。

reproach.zh: 他責備了我的粗心大意。

isle.en: They were marooned on a desert isle.
isle.zh: 她们被抛弃在一座荒岛上。

quench.en: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?
quench.zh: 你有没有什么喝的给我解渴吗？

acrobat.en: Of course, an acrobat must have a perfect sense of balance.
acrobat.zh: 当然，杂技演员必须有完美的平衡感。

lavatory.en: We have just cleaned the lavatory.

badminton.zh: 他的羽毛球打得真厉害。
他们常在这儿打羽毛球。

sociable.en: I attended the party just to be sociable.
sociable.zh: 我去那個派對純粹是為了交際。

frost.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.
A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
frost.zh: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。

thrifty.en: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.
thrifty.zh: 他勤俭节约，甚至是小气的。

dictation.en: Have you finished your homework? Have you memorized the dictation content?
dictation.zh: 這次作業做完了嗎？默寫背了嗎？

offence.en: She took offence at my word.

petrol.en: When did the petrol gauge stop working?
More and more environmentalists advocate and use environmentally friendly unleaded petrol in cars.
petrol.zh: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。

brook.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

fortnight.en: We want to go to the Alps for a fortnight.
fortnight.zh: 我們想去阿爾卑斯山待兩週。

typist.en: She found employment as a typist.
She found a job as a typist.
typist.zh: 她找到了一份打字員的工作。

bay.en: The airport is in Osaka Bay.
Mt. Fuji as seen from Suruga Bay is beautiful.
bay.zh: 從駿河灣看, 富士山很美麗。

practise.en: She practises the piano every day.
Do you still practise your religion?

speciality.en: Mu shu pork is my speciality.

lorry.en: I was almost hit by a lorry.
In Britain a truck is referred to as a lorry.

telegraph.en: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
telegraph.zh: 你知道誰發明了電報機嗎？

civilize.en: All civilized countries are against war.
civilize.zh: 所有文明的國家都反對戰爭。

civilize.en: Europeans tried to civilize the tribe.
civilize.zh: 欧洲人试着去教化部落的人

aeroplane.en: The sky was filled with aeroplanes.

lord.en: My Lord I lose the game.

bush.zh: 布什继里根之后当上了总统。

situated.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
situated.zh: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

grey.en: Mr. Grey didn't enjoy his work.
grey.zh: 格雷先生不喜歡他的工作。

ruby.en: A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
ruby.zh: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。

manoeuvre.en: Do you know the Heimlich manoeuvre?
manoeuvre.zh: 你知道海姆利克急救法吗？

queen.en: She makes people feel like queens.
queen.zh: 她給人一種女王的感覺。

pearl.en: These pearls are genuine, not artificial.
pearl.zh: 这些珍珠是真的，不是人造的。

eagle.en: The eagle does not catch flies.

centre.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
centre.zh: 抱歉，地鐵幾號線去市中心？

centre.en: She rented a flat close the to the city centre.
centre.zh: 她在離市中心不遠處租了間公寓。

programme.zh: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？

mile.en: This river is one mile across.
I walked three-fourths of a mile.

realise.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.
realise.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。

realise.en: He finally realised his brother is missing.
realise.zh: 他最终发现他弟弟不见了。

metre.en: String is sold by the metre.

ton.zh: 萨米收到了一大堆邮件。

pint.en: Beer is sold by the pint.
Milk is sold by the pint.

kilometre.en: My city is fifty kilometres from the capital.
kilometre.zh: 我的城市离首都五十千米。

apologise.en: I won’t forgive you unless you apologise sincerely.
apologise.zh: 我不会原谅你，除非你真诚地道歉。

pants.en: You just got pantsed in the schoolyard, four-eyes.
pants.zh: 你跟他比可差远了，四眼田鸡。

ounce.en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
ounce.zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。

cent.en: You gave me only fifty cents.
You only gave me fifty cents.

kilo.en: I'd like two kilos of apples.
How much for half a kilo?

ox.en: What is permitted to Jove is not permitted to an ox.
ox.zh: 朱庇特能做的，公牛做不得。

calorie.en: High calorie foods are bad for my health.
calorie.zh: 高卡路里的食物對我的身體不好。

quart.en: I want a quart of milk.

congratulation.zh: 衷心祝賀你的生日，穆里爾！
